data.description: Discover Elegant Living Amidst Tranquil Waters: Jumeirah Islands

data.answer: The lifestyle at Jumeirah Islands is focused on tranquility and luxury, with each island offering a quiet, secluded atmosphere. The community is equipped with a range of amenities that enhance the living experience, including a world-class clubhouse, fitness facilities, and restaurants. This self-contained community is ideal for families and those seeking a peaceful living space with the convenience of city life just a short drive away. Jumeirah Islands is one of the freehold areas of Dubai where expats can easily purchase a property.

You can choose from an array of luxury residential properties, including 4 to 5-bedroom Jumeirah Islands villas. These houses are divided into six clusters: European, Islamic, Mediterranean, Oasis, Tropical, and Contemporary. Each villa is further categorized into three styles: Garden Hall, Master View, and Entertainment Foyer.

There is another collection of 5-bedroom villas called Jumeriah Islands Mansions. Moreover, Jumeirah Island Townhouses are situated near the Jumeirah Islands Pavilion. These 4-bedroom homes are divided into three blocks—A, B, and C—each offering a total living space of 3,630 sq. ft.

Buying a Property in Jumeirah Islands

Looking for properties to buy in Jumeirah Island? You can find various Jumeirah Islands villas for sale. The starting price for 4-bedroom Jumeirah Islands houses is approximately AED 5.5 million. Meanwhile, a 5-bedroom villa in the same area can be purchased for just over AED 17.9 million.

If you're interested in exploring properties in the area, Provident’s real estate specialists are ready to assist you. Learn about both off-plan and secondary properties, or receive tailored advice on property options to suit your needs. Contact us today for expert guidance.

Rental Properties in Jumeirah Islands

Renting properties in Jumeirah Islands is an excellent option for tenants. It takes a minimum of AED 380k to rent a 4-bed villa in the Jumeirah Islands for a year. To rent a 5-bed villa in the Jumeirah Islands, one has to pay a minimum sum of AED 650k per year.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Jumeirah Islands?

data.answer:
Living in Jumeirah Islands offers a serene and luxurious lifestyle, characterized by picturesque waterways and lush landscapes. This self-contained community is ideal for families and individuals seeking a tranquil environment without sacrificing the conveniences of urban living. The area boasts a variety of amenities including fitness centers, community parks, and playgrounds. Social life in the §Jumeirah Islands can be vibrant, with various community events and activities organized regularly, fostering a strong sense of community among residents.

Public Transportation in Jumeirah Islands

Public transportation options in the Jumeirah Islands are currently limited, with the community primarily designed for private vehicle access. Residents typically rely on taxis or personal cars to commute. However, the connectivity is set to improve with planned extensions of the Dubai Metro and increased bus service routes, which will enhance accessibility to and from the area. This will make traveling to nearby commercial hubs and attractions more convenient for residents.

Additionally, this prime location offers easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, making it conveniently reachable from various parts of the city

Supermarkets in Jumeirah Islands Dubai

Jumeirah Islands hosts a selection of supermarkets that cater to the daily needs of its residents. The community features well-known chains such as Spinneys and Carrefour, providing a wide range of products from groceries to household items. Moreover, Choithram Jumeirah Island provides residents with easy access to all essentials.

Shopping Malls in and Near Jumeirah Islands

Jumeirah Islands Pavilion Dubai is a convenient retail option for residents. Jumeirah Islands is also located near several major shopping malls, providing residents with a plethora of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Notable malls include the Dubai Marina Mall, just a 10-minute drive away, and the Mall of the Emirates, approximately 15 minutes by car. These malls not only offer a diverse range of shops and boutiques but also feature cinemas, indoor skiing, and direct access to luxury hotels, enhancing the shopping and leisure experience for those living in Jumeirah Islands.

Schools and Nurseries in Jumeirah Islands

Jumeirah Islands is surrounded by several reputable educational institutions catering to various age groups. Nurseries such as Raffles Nursery in Lakes, and schools like Dubai British School in Emirates Hills, are within a 10-minute drive from the community. Additionally, the area is close to Regent International School and Emirates International School, both approximately a 15-minute drive away. These institutions are known for their high standards and diverse curriculums, providing excellent educational options for families residing in the Jumeirah Islands.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Jumeirah Islands

Religious facilities are readily accessible to residents of the Jumeirah Islands. The community itself features a mosque located centrally for daily prayers. For Christian residents, churches are available within a 20-minute drive in areas like Al Barsha and Jebel Ali. The nearest Hindu temple is about 30 minutes away in Bur Dubai, which caters to the Hindu community. This proximity to diverse religious sites underscores the multicultural fabric of Dubai and provides residents with the means to observe their religious practices conveniently.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Jumeirah Islands

Healthcare facilities near Jumeirah Islands are both modern and accessible. For immediate medical care, the community is serviced by Mediclinic Meadows, just a 10-minute drive away, offering a range of medical services and specialists.

For more comprehensive medical facilities, Saudi German Hospital and Al Zahra Hospital in Al Barsha are within a 20-minute driving distance. These hospitals are equipped with state-of-the-art medical technology and provide emergency services, specialty treatment, and general healthcare services to meet the needs of Jumeirah Islands residents.

Jumeirah Islands Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Jumeirah Islands is strategically situated in the heart of New Dubai, between Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) and Emirates Living. Moreover, Jumeirah Heights is located opposite the area, while Jumeirah Park and Palm Jumeirah are also nearby.

Nearby prominent areas include Dubai Marina, approximately a 10-minute drive away, and the bustling business districts of  Dubai Media City, within a similar distance. The proximity to major commercial hubs and leisure destinations like the beaches of JBR makes the Jumeirah Islands a desirable residential choice for those seeking both tranquility and urban convenience.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Jumeirah Islands

data.answer:
Jumeirah Islands offers a plethora of activities to engage its residents. The community itself features landscaped gardens, serene water features, and scenic walking paths ideal for leisurely strolls or jogging. For fitness enthusiasts, there are state-of-the-art gymnasiums and swimming pools.

The Jumeirah Islands Club provides various recreational facilities, including tennis courts and a fitness center. Additionally, the community often hosts markets and social gatherings, creating a vibrant communal atmosphere. Residents can also enjoy kayaking around the islands or dining at waterfront restaurants within the development.

Jumeirah Islands Restaurants & Bars

Dining in the Jumeirah Islands is a delightful experience, with several restaurants and bars offering a range of culinary choices. The Jumeirah Islands Clubhouse is a popular dining spot that features restaurants with menus that cater to diverse palates, offering everything from casual dining to fine gourmet experiences.

The area also includes chic cafes and family-friendly eateries with views of the picturesque lakes and lush landscapes.  The Hamptons Jumeirah Islands is a boutique café, inspired by the heritage and lifestyle of New York's Hamptons region. For more vibrant nightlife, residents can easily access the numerous upscale bars and restaurants in the nearby Dubai Marina or JLT, providing endless options for dining and socializing.

Beaches Near Jumeirah Islands

Popular nearby options include the beaches around Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) and the Dubai Marina, both approximately a 15-minute drive from Jumeirah Islands. These beaches are well-equipped with amenities such as sun loungers, water sports facilities, and vibrant beach clubs, making them perfect for family outings or relaxing days spent by the water.

Hotels Near Jumeirah Islands Dubai

While Jumeirah Islands itself is primarily a residential area, it is located near some of Dubai's most luxurious hotels. Nearby, the iconic Address Montgomerie is renowned for its hospitality and scenic views of the Montgomerie Golf Club, and it's just a short drive away.

Additionally, the Bonnington Hotel in Jumeirah Lakes Towers offers five-star accommodations and is conveniently close, about a 10-minute drive from Jumeirah Islands. These hotels provide exceptional amenities including fine dining restaurants, spas, and business facilities, catering to both leisure and business travelers.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Jumeirah Islands

Jumeirah Islands is surrounded by several attractions and landmarks that add to its appeal. The area is close to the Montgomerie Golf Club, a world-class facility perfect for golf enthusiasts. For families, the nearby Dubai Butterfly Garden and Dubai Miracle Garden offer enchanting experiences with nature.

The architectural marvel of Ain Dubai, the world’s largest observation wheel located in Bluewaters Island, is also a short drive away, providing spectacular views of Dubai’s coastline and landmarks. These attractions make Jumeirah Islands a strategically positioned community offering both tranquility and proximity to major tourist highlights.

Outdoor Activities, Salons and Gyms

The area consists of scenic walking and cycling paths that make it ideal for outdoor fitness enthusiasts. For relaxation and grooming, residents have access to several high-end salons that offer a range of beauty and wellness treatments. These include The Loft Fifth Avenue and Chloe's Beauty. Additionally, the community boasts state-of-the-art gym facility called RAISE equipped with modern fitness equipment and often hosting various fitness classes.

The area is known for its luxurious properties and exclusive lifestyle, which come with a higher price tag. This includes not only the cost of purchasing or renting homes but also maintenance fees, utility expenses, and the cost of amenities and services within the community. Such costs might be a significant consideration for those budgeting more conservatively.

Is Jumeirah Islands a good place to live?

Yes, Jumeirah Islands is considered a good place to live, especially for those looking for a luxurious and serene environment. The community is well-known for its spacious villas, beautiful lake views, and lush landscaping. It offers a variety of amenities including a fitness center, restaurants, and a shopping center, along with excellent security, making it a desirable location for families and individuals seeking a high standard of living.

How many villas are in Jumeirah Islands?

Jumeirah Islands consists of around 736 villas. These villas are distributed across 50 small islands, each offering unique architectural styles and layouts, catering to various preferences and family sizes.

Is Jumeirah Islands gated?

Yes, Jumeirah Islands is a gated community. This feature enhances the security and privacy for its residents, making it a safe and secure environment. The community also features 24-hour security and controlled access points.

How many clusters are in Jumeirah Islands?

Jumeirah Islands is divided into 46 clusters, with each cluster typically comprising 16 villas. Each cluster is set on a separate island within the larger development, surrounded by artificial lakes, which adds to the exclusivity and scenic beauty of the area.

What apartment types does Jumeirah Island offer?

Jumeirah Island primarily offers luxury villas, but it also includes some exclusive townhouses and apartments designed for upscale living.

What are the transportation options in Jumeirah Island?

Transportation options in Jumeirah Island include private cars, taxis, ride-sharing services, and community shuttle buses. The area is well-connected by major roads, making it easy to access other parts of Dubai.

Which metro is near for Jumeirah Island?

The nearest metro station to Jumeirah Island is the DMCC Metro Station (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre), which is a short drive away.

data.content:
Jumeirah Islands is a water-themed residential community located in the heart of Dubai. The luxury island consists of 50 small islands, each clustered around its private lake.

The properties on Jumeirah Island are designed with distinctive architectural styles ranging from Islamic to Mediterranean influences, providing a visually stunning environment that appeals to a diverse range of tastes. The area is developed by master developer Nakheel Properties.

Strategically located near Dubai Marina and other pivotal areas like Jumeirah Lake Towers and the Emirates Golf Club, Jumeirah Islands offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major landmarks and business hubs.

nodes.title: Eltiera Views
nodes.about:
Eltiera Views by Ellington is a design-led residential sanctuary composed of four contemporary towers set within the tranquil landscape of Jumeirah Islands. Inspired by the flowing movement of the surrounding lakes and sculpted greenery, the development blends modern architecture with refined living, offering spacious 1–3 bedroom apartments and 3 - 4 penthouses framed by calming water and skyline views. Each residence is shaped around natural light and balance, featuring warm textures, generous layouts, and thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces.

Beyond its homes, Eltiera Views features multi-layered amenities spread across the interconnected podium, including wellness zones, infinity pools, co-working areas, and dedicated children’s spaces. With curated retail and F&B at ground level and seamless access to JLT, Dubai Marina, and Sheikh Zayed Road, the four-tower community offers a lifestyle where tranquility and connectivity align effortlessly.

nodes.title: Altiera Heights
nodes.about:
Altiera Heights at Jumeirah Islands introduces a striking new dimension of upscale living in the serene enclave of Jumeirah Heights. Rising elegantly across 40 floors with 355 premium units, the development offers a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments along with expansive 4-bedroom penthouses. Crafted with Ellington Properties' signature design ethos, the project harmonizes modern aesthetics with a serene natural environment, delivering a lifestyle rooted in sophistication and tranquility.

Residents will experience thoughtfully integrated amenities including a 40-metre infinity pool, wellness spa, and both indoor and outdoor fitness areas. The architectural layout enhances natural light and panoramic views, with spaces curated for both relaxation and recreation. A clubhouse, game terrace, and outdoor greenhouse pavilion complement the lifestyle offering, setting a new benchmark in community living.y.

nodes.title: Serenia District West
nodes.about:
Serenia District West Residence by Palma Holding is a distinguished addition to one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations. Nestled within the prestigious Jumeirah Islands, this 46-story tower offers an exclusive collection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments.

West Residence is an integral part of Serenia District, which is seamlessly integrated into the larger Jumeirah Islands community. Spanning 600,000 sq. ft., Serenia District is a meticulously planned community designed to elevate residents' lifestyles. It features six elegantly designed residential towers, podium townhouses, and six dedicated lifestyle zones that promote wellness, social engagement, and leisure. Designed by the renowned architectural firm Nikken Sekkei, the residences embody sophistication with their Japanese-inspired aesthetics, blending contemporary elegance with serene natural elements.
